summary: Ferrari N.V. furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) on September 17, 2026, disclosing that wholly-owned subsidiary Ferrari S.p.A. signed a partnership agreement with Rakuten Group, Inc., effective January 1, 2027. The exhibit is a short press release; no financial terms, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock were stated. This is an ordinary commercial marketing partnership contract rather than a special situation, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
